shows: Plan-view hillshaded colour-coded DEM of the 18 Jul 2013 multibeam survey with its own NZ-grid '+' ticks (20 m) and a continuous colour bar (-0.19 to -4.90 m, at the right edge of the raster): the delta-wing '7' with the three west-arm bags, the two-bag south arm, the two NE bags and the deflated apex bags (arrowed in the report).

how_used: Second raster of the Fig 3 survey, used by the verifier to check shape.json (source ctx9): ticks read (4.2165 px/m), hue -> colour bar -> depth (open seabed NE -3.13 m CD = Fig 3 -3.1 m). Correction: this raster DOES contain a colour bar. 3D model (2026-10-07): the 1 m hue-decoded DEM of this figure is the "2013 survey surface (evidence)" layer of 3d/index.html (model.js survey2013, +-0.15 m), the reference for the inner (rise) profile of the reef, the crest check and the Navionics datum test; annotated/mmr_model_checks.png overlays the modelled sections (x = -20 and +20 m) and the model volume-versus-bed curves on it.
